title: Preview fixture template
excerpt: Synthetic template used to preview blog layout. This is not a published article.
seoDescription: Labeled preview fixture for blog layout review. Not a published article and not customer-facing copy.
intro: PREVIEW-FIXTURE-TEMPLATE-NOT-FOR-PUBLICATION. This page is a layout template. Replace every bracketed field with approved copy before any article can be published.

hero.label: Intended shot: 16:9 hero. Owned or licensed photo of the appliance or part discussed in the approved article. No stock repair photos and no customer or address details.
hero.alt: Labeled 16:9 intended-shot placeholder. No photograph is attached.
hero.caption: Optional caption. Describe the real photo when one is added.

body.text: [Paragraph] Explain the topic in plain language. Do not invent business facts, prices, credentials, or repair outcomes here.
[Paragraph] Keep the article in a single readable column. Link to a real service or area page only when that page is relevant to the approved topic.

image.label: Intended shot: 4:3 diagnostic detail. Use object-contain so labels, model plates, or part edges stay uncropped.
image.alt: Labeled 4:3 intended-shot placeholder for an uncropped diagnostic photo. No photograph is attached.
image.caption: Optional caption for the diagnostic photo.

homeownerChecks: [Homeowner check] A safe observation a homeowner can make without opening sealed components or moving the appliance.
[Homeowner check] Replace this line with approved copy. Do not include customer names or street addresses.
technicianOnly: [Technician only] Work that needs a trained technician, such as sealed-system, gas, or live-electrical repair.
[Technician only] Replace this line with approved copy.
